name: Liaozhai: Hua Pi Gui
source:
During the Jiajing era of the Ming Dynasty, the ancient city of Sui'an had not yet sunk beneath the lake; it was still a thriving, prosperous city in western Zhejiang.

Shuijsheng's opera troupe received an invitation to perform for a ritual sacrifice to the "River God," and the destination was none other than this ancient capital, nestled between mountains and water.

However, during the journey, he slipped and fell into the river. Contracting a severe illness, his life hung by a thread, until he was saved by Qingqing, a drowned ghost.

From then on, cloaked in a sinister "demonic skin," he was reduced to a half-human, half-ghost existence. His flesh gradually decayed, and his time grew short.

Qingqing informed him that only by consuming her spectral form could he extend his life. His junior apprentice sister, however, said it would be better to pray for divine mercy to overcome this calamity.

Shuijsheng gradually realized he had stepped into a labyrinthine plot that connected the realms of humans, ghosts, and gods...

He must uncover the truth within the profound depths of the ancient city, make a choice between Qingqing and his junior apprentice sister, and find his own path to redemption.

[Edited from [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4021870]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
明嘉靖年间，绥安古城尚未沉入湖中，那还是浙西一座繁华、繁荣的城市。

水生的戏班接到祭祀“河神”的邀请，目的地正是这座依山傍水的古都。

然而，在旅途中，他滑倒了，掉进了河里。身患重病，命悬一线，被落水鬼青青救起。

从此，他披上了险恶的“魔皮”，沦为半人半鬼的存在。他的肉身逐渐腐烂，他的时间也越来越短。

青青告诉他，只有吃掉她的幽灵，才能延长自己的生命。但他的师妹却说，还是祈求神明慈悲，才能渡过这次劫难吧。

水生渐渐发现自己踏入了一个连接人、鬼、神的迷宫剧情……

他必须在古城深处揭开真相，在青青和师妹之间做出选择，找到属于自己的救赎之路。
